With that in mind, the Guardian has had a go at deciding which male player is best associated with each squad number, from 1-50.

Various factors were taken into consideration, including how long a player wore/has worn that number, what they achieved/have achieved in it, why they decided to wear it in the first place and, in some cases, how distinctly it has become associated with them in death.
